<infobox theme="Media">
	<image source="image"></image>
    <title source="name"></title>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Attribution information</header>
        <data source="director"><label>Director(s)</label></data>
        <data source="writer"><label>Writer(s)</label></data>
        <data source="music"><label>Music by</label></data>
        <data source="basis"><label>Basis</label></data>
    </group>
    <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Production information</header>
        <data source="premiere date"><label>Premiere date</label></data>
        <data source="closing date"><label>Closing date</label></data>
        <data source="premiere location"><label>Premiere location</label></data>
        <data source="productions"><label>Productions</label></data>
    </group>
        <group collapse="open">
    	<header>Chronological information</header>
        <data source="timeline"><label>Timeline</label></data>
        <data source="series"><label>Series</label></data>
    </group>
	<navigation><small>{{PlainLink|//starwars.fandom.com/wiki/Template:LiveShow|name=<nowiki>[</nowiki>Source<nowiki>]</nowiki>}}</small></navigation>
</infobox>{{PreloadCat}}<!-- TEMPLATE ENDS HERE.
